1. Introduction 
This handbook provides step-by-step instructions for troubleshooting barcode scanners when 
used with the TinkerPro POS system. It covers common issues, diagnostic steps, and solutions to 
ensure smooth operation.

2. Checking Power & Connections 
• Ensure the scanner is securely plugged into the USB port. 
• Try another USB port on the POS terminal. 
• Check if the cable is damaged; replace if necessary. 
• For wireless scanners, confirm the battery is charged.

3. Testing the Scanner 
• Open Notepad or Word and scan a barcode. 
• If numbers/characters appear, the scanner is working correctly. 
• If nothing appears, reset the scanner to factory defaults using the reset barcode in the manual. 
• Ensure the scanner is in HID (Keyboard) mode.

 

4. Verifying with TinkerPro POS 
• Ensure the cursor is in the product search/code field before scanning. 
• Verify the product’s barcode is registered in the POS database. 
• If barcode is not recognized, register the product in the POS system.

5. Fixing Scanning Issues 
• Clean the scanner lens. 
• Avoid direct glare or poor lighting conditions. 
• Ensure barcode is not scratched, faded, or too small. 
• Adjust scanner sensitivity settings from the configuration guide.

6. Software Troubleshooting 
• Restart both the scanner and TinkerPro POS software. 
• Check for software updates for TinkerPro POS. 
• Test with another scanner to confirm if the issue is hardware-related.
